entries.title: Neural Constellation Memory Orbits
entries.description: A transparent brain-shaped volume filled with small colored spheres (memories) that orbit glowing neuron nodes, where unused spheres slowly fade, drift outward, and detach into a dim “forgetting cloud,” while frequently re-activated spheres brighten and tighten their orbits with visible connection lines.

entries.title: Sandcastle of Memories and Tides of Forgetting
entries.description: A detailed sandcastle built from stacked sand blocks labeled as memories on a beach, with gentle waves that gradually erode, detach, and dissolve outer blocks into particles, while new labeled sand blocks are added by a small builder sphere that rolls in from the side.

entries.title: Filing Cabinet of Remembered and Lost Notes
entries.description: A 3D cabinet with sliding transparent drawers containing colored note cards that float in and auto-stack when tagged as “remembered,” while older cards slowly turn gray, lose labels, and drift out through the back into a hazy “forgotten” bin that can occasionally send a random card back.

entries.title: Synapse Bridge with Strengthening and Decay
entries.description: Two semi-transparent neuron spheres connected by multiple elastic rods whose thickness and color intensity increase when pulses (small glowing particles) travel across them, and weaken, shrink, and eventually snap when pulses stop, sending loose particles drifting away.

entries.title: Memory Garden with Blooming and Withering Flowers
entries.description: A flat garden plane where each memory is a labeled flower that grows taller and more colorful when a bee-like agent visits it, but slowly droops, loses petals, and shrinks into the soil (forgetting) when ignored, with faint ghost-flowers occasionally re-sprouting as partial recollections.

entries.title: Library Shelves with Sliding, Fading Books
entries.description: Rows of 3D books on light-colored shelves where new books fly in from above, slide into gaps, and glow when “recalled,” while rarely accessed books lose color, become transparent, and slowly float off the shelf into a dim corner cloud of tumbling forgotten books.

entries.title: Bubble Memories Rising and Popping
entries.description: Colored bubbles representing memories rise from a floor pool, grow slightly each time a scanning beam touches them, and leave vertical trails, while unattended bubbles thin, lose color, and pop into tiny particle sprays that drift down and vanish.

entries.title: Hard Drive Sector Map with Bit Decay
entries.description: A rectangular 3D grid of small cubes (bits) that flip between bright and dim states as data is written and read, with some bits randomly flickering and dissolving (forgetting), while an error-correction agent cube roams, detecting unstable bits and re-writing them with a bright flash.

entries.title: Social Network Memory Spread and Loss
entries.description: A cluster of humanoid figures (simple cylinders and spheres) connected by glowing lines that carry “memory packets” (small colored spheres) that hop from person to person; over time, packets dim and drop off the network unless frequently passed, leaving faint ghost trails of stories once told.

entries.title: Crystal Lattice of Memories with Cracks
entries.description: A floating crystal lattice where certain nodes are lit and labeled as active memories, and stress waves propagate through the lattice causing cracks that detach some lit nodes, which tumble away and shatter into tiny shards, while other nearby nodes re-light as associated memories.

entries.title: Chalkboard of Thoughts and Erasing
entries.description: A vertical light slate where colored 3D chalk strokes (extrusions) appear for each new memory, slowly sliding down and smearing, while a semi-transparent eraser block sweeps across sections, physically knocking off chalk fragments that fall and form a faint dusty pile of forgotten residue.

entries.title: Memory Maze with Fading Paths
entries.description: A 3D maze of corridors where a small explorer sphere travels, leaving bright colored trails for remembered routes, with untraveled trails gradually dimming and shrinking until they vanish, and occasionally, faint ghost paths reappear in partial segments when the explorer nears them again.

entries.title: Protein Receptor Memory at a Synapse
entries.description: A microscopic synapse scene where vesicles carrying neurotransmitter particles dock, release, and bind to receptor sites on a membrane; receptors that are frequently used grow and cluster (LTP), while idle receptors detach, drift away, and dissolve into the fluid as forgotten connections.
